definitions.explanation: The natural satellite of the Earth.
A period of time roughly equal to one lunar cycle.

examples.japanese: {今夜|こんや}は{月|つき}がきれいだ。
{先月|せんげつ}から{毎月|まいつき}{会|あ}っている。
examples.english: We've been meeting every month since last month.

notes: For "moon," also used in {満月|まんげつ} (full moon), {三日月|みかづき} (crescent moon). For "month," see {一ヶ月|いっかげつ} (one month).
